channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: Kubecost 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kubecost is the industry standard for real-time FinOps and cost allocation across multi-cluster cloud native environments.

item.title: antigravity.google: Google Antigravity Agentic Platform
item.description: [CRITICAL] Bridges local agent prototyping to enterprise production by providing a unified SDK and target platform on Google Kubernetes Engine.

item.title: docs.anthropic.com: Claude Code CLI
item.description: [CRITICAL] Introduces an autonomous agentic CLI tool that fundamentally transforms how engineering teams execute code, run tests, and manage git workflows.

item.title: cursor.com: Cursor AI Code Editor
item.description: [CRITICAL] Redefines modern developer workflows by setting the industry benchmark for AI-first IDEs and multi-file agentic code editing.

item.title: Crossplane
item.description: [CRITICAL] Crossplane drives a major paradigm shift by transforming Kubernetes into a universal control plane for managing multi-cloud infrastructure.

item.title: NVIDIA/k8s-device-plugin: NVIDIA device plugin for Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] The NVIDIA device plugin is a foundational hardware link required to schedule and run accelerated AI and ML workloads on Kubernetes.

item.title: vLLM on Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] Standardizes efficient LLM serving and memory management on Kubernetes using PagedAttention for production cloud-native AI infrastructure.

item.title: Tetragon (Cilium)
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides cutting-edge, kernel-level eBPF security observability and real-time runtime enforcement for Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: ==dagger/dagger: Dagger is a portable devkit for CICD==
item.description: [CRITICAL] Dagger introduces a paradigm shift by replacing complex, vendor-locked YAML pipelines with portable, code-based CI/CD environments built on BuildKit.

item.title: Helm
item.description: [CRITICAL] The foundational package manager for Kubernetes that powers modern declarative deployments and serves as a vital component in GitOps pipelines.

item.title: github.com: Istio
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the dominant enterprise service mesh providing zero-trust security and modern ambient/sidecar data plane topologies.

item.title: Teleport 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] Teleport delivers essential zero-trust infrastructure access control, identity-backed session recording, and auditing across multi-region Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: github.com/kubernetes: **Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler**
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler remains the foundational core component responsible for dynamically adjusting cloud node capacity based on workload scheduling demands.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] A core CNCF GitOps engine that provides highly parallelized and decoupled multi-tenant reconciliation for Kubernetes clusters.

item.title: github.com/prometheus/prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] Remains the foundational CNCF-graduated time-series engine that defines modern Kubernetes monitoring standard practices.

item.title: containerd - An open and reliable container runtime
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the core, industry-standard container runtime engine underpinning Kubernetes production clusters globally.

item.title: runc
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the canonical low-level OCI runtime reference implementation that directly handles Linux process isolation and container creation.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] Remains the absolute cornerstone of enterprise Zero Trust architectures and secret management in multi-cloud environments.

item.title: OpenTelemetry Collector
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the universal, vendor-agnostic telemetry processing pipeline for traces, metrics, and logs in cloud-native architectures.

item.title: kube-prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides the complete reference deployment stack for end-to-end Kubernetes cluster observability out of the box.
